The '''Twi'lek warrior caste''' was a section of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] society. They were keen to show off their courage, and commissioned suits of [[Castaan Staad armor]] from [[Castaan Armory]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
